question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank marked [C].
solution:
The correct answer is '**were used**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage is narrated in the **simple past tense** (e.g., "were fed up", "tried", "suggested", "was made", "was accessorised").
 
• To maintain tense consistency, the correct form for the blank is also in the **simple past passive voice**: **"were used"**.
 
• "Bundles of straw" is the subject receiving the action (being used), so the passive form is appropriate.
 
• Other options: 
 
 
• **Has been used**: Present perfect tense — mismatched with past narration.
 
• **Are used**: Simple present — incorrect with the past narrative.
 
• **Had been used**: Past perfect — implies a past-before-past scenario, unnecessary here.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

 

Complete Sentence: *The face of the scarecrow was made using an earthen pot, while bundles of straw **were used**__ to create its arms.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Were used**: Simple past passive — correct and consistent with the rest of the passage.
 
• **Has been used**: Present perfect — tense mismatch.
 
• **Are used**: Present tense — does not fit past narration.
 
• **Had been used**: Past perfect — unnecessary complexity in this context.
